description: Compare the installed Gameye agent skills with the latest pack on GitHub, and update them. Finds installs made with the skills CLI (user-wide or in this project) and the Claude Code plugin gameye@gameye. Without apply it only checks and changes nothing. With apply=true it runs each outdated install's own updater (npx skills update for the Gameye skills only, or claude plugin update); ask the user before applying. Updates come only through those package managers; this tool never downloads or follows skill text itself.

apply.description: Run the updates for outdated installs. Omit or false to only check.

installedVersion.description: The `Pack version:` from the gameye skill you have loaded, used when no install is found on disk

name: gameye_update_skills
title: Check and update the Gameye skills
